title: Synthesis --- The Conversation Without Them
label: ch:synthesis-without-repeating
canDo: I can carry a four-turn exchange using pronouns, and say what a pronoun promises the listener.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C45-sintesis-sin-repetir: run the exchange with pronouns and say what goes wrong when the gender points at nothing.
payoff.note: States the cost as well as the benefit: a pronoun buys speed and is paid for in attention, which is the skill no grid can carry.
